tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: Window ground: the workspace panes, button rests, text-field wells and tooltip backs. Every text token reads on it.

tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: Ruled panels (the Repositories column, Explorer) and the dialog card.

tokens.name: bg-chrome
tokens.usage: The two header rows, the tab strip and the status bar: the chrome that frames the workspace.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: The active tab, a hovered row or chip, the Worktree and Remote ref pills.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, the active tab's name, field values, button labels; chrome text. On bg-app, bg-sidebar, bg-chrome, bg-raised.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy: list rows, notes, inactive tabs, Local ref pills, the default text of every pane. On bg-app, bg-sidebar, bg-chrome, chip.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Pane titles, column headers, paths, placeholders, disabled labels, chevrons, the Remote pill. Scannable, not wallpaper grey (wireframe --quiet). 5.5:1 on bg-app, 4.9:1 on bg-raised.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between chrome rows, panel rules, button borders, the header separator; also the hover wash behind a bordered button.

tokens.name: accent-primary
tokens.usage: Ember: the brand hue. The checked-out branch (chip ink, Head pill fill, active tab's branch line), focus border on fields, the primary button fill, running-activity ink, error text in the status bar. 7.2:1 on bg-app.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an accent-primary fill: the primary button label, the badge's G, the current repository tile. 7.7:1 on accent-primary.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Resting fill of the branch chip, inactive tabs, the Local and Tag ref pills, and the open tab-picker button.

tokens.name: chip-border
tokens.usage: Border of chips, inactive tabs, resting text fields and pick lists.

tokens.name: added
tokens.usage: Diff ink for added lines on added-bg; the Tag pill's ink and border; the idle status dot and a succeeded activity. 10:1 on chip.

tokens.name: removed
tokens.usage: Diff ink for removed lines on removed-bg; a failed activity in the status bar.

tokens.name: added-bg
tokens.usage: Solid, opaque wash behind an added line. Never a translucent overlay.

tokens.name: removed-bg
tokens.usage: Solid, opaque wash behind a removed line.

tokens.name: modified-bg
tokens.usage: Wash behind a changed line pair in the side-by-side diff (modified, not added or removed).

tokens.name: modified-word-bg
tokens.usage: Stronger wash behind the changed words inside a modified line.

tokens.name: added-word-bg
tokens.usage: Wash behind the inserted words inside an added line.

tokens.name: removed-word-bg
tokens.usage: Wash behind the deleted words inside a removed line.

tokens.name: vcs-modified
tokens.usage: File-status ink for a modified file's name, after the JetBrains changes view. On bg-app and bg-sidebar.

tokens.name: vcs-added
tokens.usage: File-status ink for an added (staged new) file's name.

tokens.name: vcs-deleted
tokens.usage: File-status ink for a deleted file's name.

tokens.name: vcs-untracked
tokens.usage: File-status ink for an untracked file's name. 5.4:1 on bg-app.

tokens.name: vcs-renamed
tokens.usage: File-status ink for a renamed file's name.

tokens.name: vcs-conflicted
tokens.usage: File-status ink for a conflicted file's name. 5.9:1 on bg-app.

tokens.name: incoming
tokens.usage: Commits on the upstream not here (the down arrow). Not green or red: those mean added and removed lines, which a commit count is not.

tokens.name: outgoing
tokens.usage: Commits here not yet on the upstream (the up arrow).

tokens.name: lane-0
tokens.usage: Commit-graph lane 0: the tip lane, in the brand ember. Lanes cycle through lane-0 to lane-5 by index.

tokens.name: lane-1
tokens.usage: Commit-graph lane 1. 5.3:1 on bg-app.

tokens.name: lane-2
tokens.usage: Commit-graph lane 2.

tokens.name: lane-3
tokens.usage: Commit-graph lane 3. 4.9:1 on bg-app.

tokens.name: lane-4
tokens.usage: Commit-graph lane 4.

tokens.name: lane-5
tokens.usage: Commit-graph lane 5.

tokens.name: scrim-dialog
tokens.usage: bg-app at 72% over the window behind a modal dialog (confirm, stash, merge, settings).

tokens.name: scrim-compare
tokens.usage: bg-app at 75% behind the Compare window.

tokens.name: scrim-palette
tokens.usage: Black at 35% behind the command palette.

tokens.name: scrim-popup
tokens.usage: Black at 25% behind the branch popup.

tokens.name: popup-shadow-ink
tokens.usage: Black at 50%: the only shadow colour, under the branch popup and the command palette (see shadow popup).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The reading size chosen under Appearance (12 to 18, default 14): list rows, labels, button text, notes, field values. Every other style is an offset from it.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The app name in the header (body + 1, bold): Git in text-secondary, Cthulhu in accent-primary.

styles.name: wordmark-caps
styles.sample: G I T C T H U L H U
styles.usage: The Spaced capitals header mark (body - 1, semibold, text-muted), letters separated by a thin space U+2009 since iced has no letter spacing.

styles.name: badge-letter
styles.usage: The heavy G on the 20px accent badge, in on-accent.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tooltips and the chevron inside a chip (body - 1, floor 10).

styles.name: compact
styles.usage: Pane titles, the status bar, a tab's branch line, picker paths (body - 2, floor 11). In text-muted unless it carries state.

styles.name: column-header
styles.usage: History column headers, 20px tall, in text-muted.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Hashes, ref names in the popup, the Shell prompt header mark, diff text. Hashes and paths stay monospace whatever face is chosen.

styles.name: mono-caption
styles.usage: A tab's tooltip: full path then branch (body - 1).

styles.name: mono-compact
styles.usage: Worktree paths in the tab picker (body - 2), in text-muted.

styles.name: glyph
styles.usage: Toolbar icon buttons (body + 1, floor 12). Line height 1 so the glyph centres in its row.

styles.name: glyph-inline
styles.usage: An icon beside text: the branch chip, labelled buttons, ref pills, file rows (body).

styles.name: glyph-compact
styles.usage: Status-bar activity icons and the fold chevron (body - 2).

spacing.note: There is no abstract scale: these are the gaps the views use, named by where. Button and chip paddings are composites and live in the component guidelines.

tokens.name: pane-gap
tokens.usage: Between workspace panes; between tabs in the strip; the tooltip gap under an icon button.

tokens.name: control-gap
tokens.usage: Between commands in a toolbar; between a glyph and its label in a chip; the explorer row's horizontal pad.

tokens.name: cluster-gap
tokens.usage: Between clusters in the header; between dialog buttons; the pane head's horizontal pad; the badge-to-name gap.

tokens.name: column-gap
tokens.usage: Between history columns; the branch chip's horizontal pad; between fields in a picker row.

tokens.name: bar-inset
tokens.usage: Horizontal inset of the header rows and the status bar; vertical rhythm between dialog rows.

tokens.name: tree-indent
tokens.usage: One level of indent in the Explorer and Changes trees; the gap between status-bar items.

tokens.name: lane-pitch
tokens.usage: Horizontal distance between commit-graph lane centres.

tokens.name: dialog-inset
tokens.usage: Padding inside the dialog card.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Ref pills, a tab's close button, the status-bar activity link.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, pick lists, tooltips, the layout-preset segments, quiet buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Worktree tabs, the tab-picker button, the header badge.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The dialog card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The branch chip: a full pill.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: The 7px status dot (half its size).

tokens.name: popup
tokens.usage: The branch popup and the command palette: the only shadow in the app. Panels, cards and buttons are bordered, never shadowed.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the views pin, in px. Widths the user drags have a default and bounds in the Layout section.

tokens.name: title-row
tokens.usage: Header identity row: mark, repository name and folder, app commands.

tokens.name: branch-row
tokens.usage: Header branch row: the chip, tracking line, branch and view commands.

tokens.name: status-bar
tokens.usage: The status bar, collapsed.

tokens.name: status-bar-expanded
tokens.usage: The status bar with an error's details open.

tokens.name: graph-row
tokens.usage: One commit row in History: one line of text, pills inline.

tokens.name: diff-row
tokens.usage: One line in the diff.

tokens.name: diff-file-row
tokens.usage: A file header in the diff.

tokens.name: diff-hunk-row
tokens.usage: A hunk header in the diff.

tokens.name: diff-note-row
tokens.usage: A note row in the diff.

tokens.name: palette-row
tokens.usage: One command in the palette.

tokens.name: repository-row
tokens.usage: One repository in the Repositories column; also the folded rail's width.

tokens.name: repository-tile
tokens.usage: The repository's initial tile in the rail.

tokens.name: repositories-column
tokens.usage: The Repositories column, pinned.

tokens.name: files-rail
tokens.usage: The Files pane folded to a rail.

tokens.name: explorer-width
tokens.usage: The Explorer before the user drags it: a pixel width, so narrowing the window narrows the log, not the tree.

tokens.name: terminal-height
tokens.usage: The terminal pane's default height (drag bounds 110 to 900).

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: The dialog card.

tokens.name: branch-popup-width
tokens.usage: The branch popup, 44px below the top; its list 460px tall.

tokens.name: palette-width
tokens.usage: The command palette, 56px below the top; its list 380px tall.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: The header badge tile.

tokens.name: status-dot
tokens.usage: The status dot at the left of the status bar.

tokens.name: checkbox
tokens.usage: The stage checkbox in Changes.

tokens.name: pill-height
tokens.usage: A ref pill in the graph; its strip clips at 180px.

tokens.name: branch-chip-max
tokens.usage: Widest the top-bar branch name grows before it clips.

tokens.name: hash-column
tokens.usage: History: the hash column.

tokens.name: when-column
tokens.usage: History: the date column.

tokens.name: author-column
tokens.usage: History: the author column.

tokens.name: line-number-column
tokens.usage: Diff: the line-number gutter; the mark column beside it is 14px.

tokens.name: search-max
tokens.usage: The filter bar's search field; its pick list 130px.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule, border and divider. There is no 2px border.

tokens.name: graph-line
tokens.usage: Commit-graph lane lines, and the stroke of a Remote tip's ring.

tokens.name: graph-dot
tokens.usage: Radius of a commit dot.

tokens.name: graph-ring
tokens.usage: Radius of the ring round a Local or Worktree tip.

tokens.name: layout-mark
tokens.usage: Thickness of the bars in the 11px layout-preset mark, 1.5px apart.

tokens.name: console-shade
tokens.usage: Shade over the terminal pane while it is dimmed.

tokens.name: context-shade
tokens.usage: Shade behind an open context menu.

tokens.name: failed-wash
tokens.usage: removed-bg at this alpha behind a failed row in Activity.
